wedo_instance.description: Proposals for optimizing the Meta-Root orchestration and forensic continuity based on Eudaimonia's boot experience.

meta.philosophy: Minimize 'metabolic heat' by automating forensic trace and hardening core scripts against regression.

tasks.description: Automated Handover: Standardize a 'handover.json' in 'dynamic/static/' that explicitly links the final WeDo of session N to the startup of session N+1, replacing the manual forensic log crawl.
Metabolic HUD Expansion: Integrate the enhanced 'metagit_map' into the boot report to automatically display a 'Dirty Repo Alert' if any of the 71 repos have uncommitted changes.
Orchestration Unit Testing: Implement a test suite for 'py/register_agent.py' and 'py/metagit_map.py' to catch Syntax/KeyErrors before they interrupt the boot sequence.
Checksum Nuance: Refactor 'verify_environment.py' to distinguish between 'Core Tool Corruption' (Hard Failure) and 'Config Evolution' (e.g., .gitignore updates - Soft Warning).
Cambium Persistence: Modify 'register_agent.py' to automatically write the formatted Markdown Boot Report to the chrono-fractal as a permanent historical record.

Straightup Mandate: Formalize the 'Straightup' command in the 'One-Word Glossary' to require that agents end relevant turns with high-density Markdown reports, and add this to 'README.ai' to ensure future agent compliance.
